note: AreaLife v97/v100: the places around Kikar Hamedina. findplace.co.il's frozen discovery file (Tel Aviv-Yafo municipality open data + OpenStreetMap, 27.8.2026, sha256 2909a0c2...), then OpenStreetMap (ODbL, (c) OpenStreetMap contributors) via Overpass, 30.09.2026; walking minutes: Mapbox Directions, walking profile, from the plot centre (provisional); what the windows see: the city's buildings layer (GIS 513) with a straight sight line, the new projects around not included. Landmarks: quarter.json (find-place: TLV OpenData + OSM). findplace covers north Tel Aviv only (north of lat 32.0845): south of it OpenStreetMap only. Kikar Hamedina additions (enrich_places_kikar.py, 2026-09-30): the Tel Aviv-Yafo municipality's GIS layers for daily life (schools and kindergartens 2026-27, daycares, clinics, pharmacies, community, culture, sport, playgrounds, gardens, synagogues); bus lines per stop from Open Bus Stride (GTFS of the Ministry of Transport, 2026-09-08); the light-rail stations of the city's layers (red running; purple and green planned); Park HaYarkon's nearest edges (OpenStreetMap). The view point and the sight lines are PROVISIONAL: from the plot centre, eye heights by formula (eye-kikar-provisional.json), the three towers left out of the obstacles; per-tower sight lines are P5. Walking minutes start on the ring road ה' באייר on the side facing each place (the plot is a closed building site; Mapbox would snap its centre 122 m south); the 5/10/15-minute areas are the union of four Mapbox walking areas from the ring's N/E/S/W points, outlined every 3 degrees.
